import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
# coords points LF RF LR RR LB
obs=np.array([[617,638],[961,547],[565,252],[916,234],[504,547]],float)
def calc(p):
 f,tilt,yaw,roll,tx,ty,tz,h,d=p
 # X, Y, Z up. Y away
 yaw=np.deg2rad(yaw);tilt=np.deg2rad(tilt);roll=np.deg2rad(roll)
 pts=np.array([[-.5,-d,0],[.5,-d,0],[-.5,0,h],[.5,0,h],[-.5,d,0],[.5,d,0]])
 Rz=np.array([[np.cos(yaw),-np.sin(yaw),0],[np.sin(yaw),np.cos(yaw),0],[0,0,1]])
 Rcam=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,-np.sin(tilt),-np.cos(tilt)],[0,np.cos(tilt),-np.sin(tilt)]])
 Rroll=np.array([[np.cos(roll),-np.sin(roll),0],[np.sin(roll),np.cos(roll),0],[0,0,1]])
 R=Rroll@Rcam@Rz
 cam=pts@R.T+np.array([tx,ty,tz]);proj=cam[:,:2]/cam[:,2,None]*f+[640,360]
 return proj,R,cam

def fun(p):
 proj,R,c=calc(p)
 return np.r_[(proj[:5]-obs).ravel(), (p[0]-1400)*.002,(p[3])*1,(p[7]-.98)*3]
